title: AvsAgent
tagline: Verifiable AI Agent using EigenLayer AVS. Verify the prompts response recieved by AI Agents using AVS's
description: Verifiable AI agents using Eigenlayer AVS leverage the AVS framework to ensure that the actions and decisions of AI systems can be independently verified on the blockchain. By integrating Eigenlayer’s security model, these agents benefit from aggregated proofs, making their computations transparent and auditable. This enables enhanced trust and accountability, ensuring AI agents' decisions are secure, traceable, and verifiable within decentralized ecosystems, particularly in domains requiring high assurance, like finance and healthcare.
